segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.text: There is an objection to the motion to amend by substitution the entire bill.

segments.text: Madam Speaker, I object and I invoke the five-minute rule to explain my objection.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Prior to the explanation of your vote, may we request...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Not my vote, my objection, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Okay, you have five minutes, Honorable Tino. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, I object to the amendment by substitution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: First of all, because of the point we raised earlier,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: it is not transparent to give the report of BARC that details what are the amendments that were made.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And our colleagues said earlier that it is not enough to say that it is in the live stream.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Having said that, we also looked at the amendments in the live stream.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We looked at them one by one and it shows that a total of P116 billion was saved here, P116.32 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang pinakamalaking mga amendments ay para sa dagdag sa MAIFIP, that's over 28 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa DSWD, 26 billion, yan yung AICS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa Department of, sa DOLE, 5.11 billion para sa Tupad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa LGSF, binagdagan pa ng 4.09 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa TESDA, 1.44 billion pangunahin sa mga scholarships.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So ito yung mga ayuda programs ng iba't ibang mga ahensyang ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: which among others requires or involves the discretion of legislators

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So kaya may pagtutulpo tayo ron.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos, may mga inamend din po, for example, sa DPWH budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So nadagdagan yung total, pero actually internally,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: internally ay 98.8 billion pesos po ang total na binago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: individual projects na wala sa NEP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pero nandito na sa amended House version na pinapapasa sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Unfortunately, dahil nga hindi na-present at nabigyan tayo ng report,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: hindi alam ng publiko at ng nakararaming mga miyembro ang mga amendments na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, for all of these reasons, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: samantala, inod din natin na yung ilang mga demands na nire-raise,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: katulad nung substantial increase in personnel economic relief allowance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung pagtiyak na mapopondohan ang free higher education deficiency

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung production subsidy para sa mga magsasaka at mangingisda,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung pagdagdag sa budget ng edukasyon sa mga public hospitals at iba pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: lalo pa ngayon na napakatindi ng inflation, 7.2% po ang latest inflation figures.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa tingin po natin, ay hindi matutugunan ng amendments,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: via substitution, ang mga pangangailangan ito ng sambayan ng Pilipino,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: nananatiling pangunahin sa P116B, almost P100B,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ay matatawag na pork type amendments, both para sa ayuda at para sa infrastructure,
